entries.title: Jeremiah 17:1
segments: ¶"The sin of Judah [is] written with a pen of iron; With the point of a diamond [it is] engraved On the tablet of their heart, And on the horns of your altars,

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:2
segments: While their children remember Their altars and their wooden images By the green trees on the high hills.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:3
segments: O My mountain in the field, I will give as plunder your wealth, all your treasures, [And] your high places of sin within all your borders.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:4
segments: And you, even yourself, Shall let go of your heritage which I gave you; And I will cause you to serve your enemies In the land which you do not know; For you have kindled a fire in My anger [which] shall burn forever."

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:5
segments: ¶Thus says the LORD: "Cursed [is] the man who trusts in man And makes flesh his strength, Whose heart departs from the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:6
segments: For he shall be like a shrub in the desert, And shall not see when good comes, But shall inhabit the parched places in the wilderness, [In] a salt land [which is] not inhabited.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:7
segments: "Blessed [is] the man who trusts in the LORD, And whose hope is the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:8
segments: For he shall be like a tree planted by the waters, Which spreads out its roots by the river, And will not fear when heat comes; But its leaf will be green, And will not be anxious in the year of drought, Nor will cease from yielding fruit.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:9
segments: "The heart [is] deceitful above all [things], And desperately wicked; Who can know it?

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:10
segments: I, the LORD, search the heart, [I] test the mind, Even to give every man according to his ways, According to the fruit of his doings.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:11
segments: "[As] a partridge that broods but does not hatch, [So is] he who gets riches, but not by right; It will leave him in the midst of his days, And at his end he will be a fool."

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:12
segments: ¶A glorious high throne from the beginning [Is] the place of our sanctuary.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:13
segments: O LORD, the hope of Israel, All who forsake You shall be ashamed. "Those who depart from Me Shall be written in the earth, Because they have forsaken the LORD, The fountain of living waters."

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:14
segments: Heal me, O LORD, and I shall be healed; Save me, and I shall be saved, For You [are] my praise.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:15
segments: Indeed they say to me, "Where [is] the word of the LORD? Let it come now!"

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:16
segments: As for me, I have not hurried away from [being] a shepherd [who] follows You, Nor have I desired the woeful day; You know what came out of my lips; It was right there before You.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:17
segments: Do not be a terror to me; You [are] my hope in the day of doom.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:18
segments: Let them be ashamed who persecute me, But do not let me be put to shame; Let them be dismayed, But do not let me be dismayed. Bring on them the day of doom, And destroy them with double destruction!

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:19
segments: ¶Thus the LORD said to me: "Go and stand in the gate of the children of the people, by which the kings of Judah come in and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem;

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:20
segments: "and say to them, 'Hear the word of the LORD, you kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, who enter by these gates.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:21
segments: 'Thus says the LORD: "Take heed to yourselves, and bear no burden on the Sabbath day, nor bring [it] in by the gates of Jerusalem;

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:22
segments: "nor carry a burden out of your houses on the Sabbath day, nor do any work, but hallow the Sabbath day, as I commanded your fathers.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:23
segments: "But they did not obey nor incline their ear, but made their neck stiff, that they might not hear nor receive instruction.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:24
segments: "And it shall be, if you heed Me carefully," says the LORD, "to bring no burden through the gates of this city on the Sabbath day, but hallow the Sabbath day, to do no work in it,

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:25
segments: "then shall enter the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on the throne of David, riding in chariots and on horses, they and their princes, accompanied by the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and this city shall remain forever.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:26
segments: "And they shall come from the cities of Judah and from the places around Jerusalem, from the land of Benjamin and from the lowland, from the mountains and from the South, bringing burnt offerings and sacrifices, grain offerings and incense, bringing sacrifices of praise to the house of the LORD.

entries.title: Jeremiah 17:27
segments: "But if you will not heed Me to hallow the Sabbath day, such as not carrying a burden when entering the gates of Jerusalem on the Sabbath day, then I will kindle a fire in its gates, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem, and it shall not be quenched."'"
